row.team_price_text: Heroku Teams: no seat fee; dynos and add-ons billed at normal usage rates (Basic dyno $7/mo)
row.evidence: Heroku's public roadmap item 'Manage Heroku User Identities with SCIM' (#149) is still open and says Heroku is 'considering' SCIM; the SSO docs say accounts are created by JIT on first IdP login and removing a user from the IdP 'doesn't remove the account from Heroku'.
row.notes: Unchanged from June: no SCIM at any tier. SAML SSO is available on Heroku Teams and Heroku Enterprise, with JIT account creation at first IdP login; deprovisioning is manual (remove from team, or contact Heroku Support to delete the federated account). Team plan changed from 'Eco' to 'Heroku Teams': Eco dynos are 'Personal accounts only' and not available to Teams, while Heroku Teams has no seat fee (Heroku says it 'previously charged $10/month for teams larger than 5 people') and resources are usage-priced, so per-user fields are null. The Platform API exposes team-member and enterprise-account-member CRUD on every account, and Okta's only provisioning app is Aquera's third-party connector (no status change). Audit Trail (monthly archive and events API) is for Enterprise Accounts. June's '$5/mo flat' Eco figure is still on the pricing page but is not a team tier.

plans.name: Personal account (Eco dynos)
plans.notes: Eco dynos are for personal accounts only; usage-priced, not per seat.

plans.name: Heroku Teams
plans.price_text: No seat fee; team-owned dynos, add-ons and services charged at normal rates (Basic dyno $7/mo)
plans.notes: Up to five Teams per account and 25 members per Team.

deprovision.data_retained: No SCIM. Removing a user from the IdP blocks SSO login but does not remove the Heroku account; admins must remove the member from the team, and deleting a JIT-created account requires contacting Heroku Support.

limitations.text: SCIM is an open item on Heroku's public roadmap (issue #149, opened Feb 17, 2023), described as under consideration.

endpoints.purpose: Create a new team member, or update their role
Remove a member from the team
List members in an enterprise account
Create a member in an enterprise account
Update a member in an enterprise account
Delete a member in an enterprise account
List audit trail events (one day per call)

rate_limits.text: Each account has a pool of up to 4500 request tokens, refilled at about 75 per minute; 429 when exhausted.

limitations.text: Federated (SSO) users removed from the IdP keep their Heroku account; deletion of a JIT-created account goes through Heroku Support.

okta.notes: The 'Salesforce Heroku' OIN app has only SAML checked (read from page markup); provisioning is only through Aquera's connector. A separate 'Salesforce Heroku SWA' app also exists.

entra.notes: Tutorial covers SAML SSO with just-in-time user creation only.

google.notes: From Heroku's own list of IdPs with built-in SSO support (Google Cloud Identity); Google's catalogue page not checked.

onelogin.notes: From Heroku's own list of IdPs with built-in SSO support; OneLogin connector pages block bots.

jumpcloud.notes: https://jumpcloud.com/support/integrate-with-heroku redirects to the generic help index.
